<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Delete dashboard folder</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"delete"} path={"/perses-public/api/v1/projects/{projectId}"}></MethodEndpoint>



Deletes a folder and every dashboard inside it. There is no check that the folder is empty.

The deletion is soft: the folder and its dashboards stop appearing in every endpoint of this API. Creating a folder with the same `metadata.name` later restores this one.
